extraction.boundaryPolicy: conservative-inside source-mask edge bisection; mixed leaves retained as UV triangles
extraction.regionPolicy: authored region classification at adaptive-cell center

tailAuthoring.reason: Reduce accumulated child rotation to retain visible pelvis-behind-legs-left-bottom source trajectory

distalPivotCompensation.preservedRelativeBend: authored tail9 world wind-up/release plus delayed tail10..15 local bend; world pivot position retained
distalPivotCompensation.interpolation: ordinary existing key translation lerp/quaternion slerp; pivot exact at keys, no continuous runtime constraint

tailContinuity.visibleLowerCurlPolicy: after unchanged leg classification: y>1000&&x<300 || y>1108&&x<430; classification only on existing source mask
tailContinuity.freeCurlPolicy: y>1000&&x<300 || y>1108&&x<430 retains original tail-chain weights; generic axe/torso/arm anchors excluded
tailContinuity.residual: Only visible source islands are skinned. Hidden leg/hand-occluded texture remains unavailable; public pose review must judge thinning/self-intersection.

provenance.sourceGap: SOURCE GAP / 숨은 면 미확보: Tail segments occluded by the two legs and right hand have no independent texture in the source; only visible islands are meshed. No hidden surface reconstruction.
provenance.footPolicy: Static pelvis/leg tracks; source perspective offsets preserved, no native physical ground claim
